name: final-commit
description: A sci-fi creature-collection game built from your real dev work.

generationModel.title: System generation model
generationModel.description: Model that charts a star system, one call per epic.

privacyMode.title: Privacy filter
privacyMode.description: Filter applied to epic text before it reaches the model. strict also removes capitalized words that could be names.

devMode.title: Developer mode
devMode.description: Enables /encounter, which forces an encounter for playtesting.

workSources.title: Work sources
workSources.description: Trackers read for automatic detection, by name (SPEC 4.4). Available: plans, github, jira.

plansFolders.title: Plan folders
plansFolders.description: Folders of markdown plan documents read by the plans work source, relative to the project.

githubRepos.title: GitHub repositories
githubRepos.description: Repositories the github work source reads, each with its key prefix: owner/repo=PREFIX (issue #12 becomes PREFIX-12). Read through the gh CLI and its own login.

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Your Jira Cloud site, like https://example.atlassian.net. Only an atlassian.net site is accepted, and the API token is sent only to this site.

jiraEmail.title: Jira email
jiraEmail.description: The email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to.

jiraToken.title: Jira API token
jiraToken.description: An Atlassian API token (id.atlassian.com, Security, API tokens). Stored by Claude Code in secure storage, never in the repository or the game's save.
